messages:
morgan: quick ping — PR #4321 updates the attention kernel prefetch and batching heuristic. moved prefetch window logic into runtime/prefetch.cpp and adjusted batch grouping to avoid starvation. would love eyes, aiming to merge by EOW so next deploy picks it up.

kai: can you drop perf numbers? any regressions? where's the fallback if prefetch buffer misses?

sasha: tagged as reviewer, will look in ~1h.

morgan: perf summary: +9% throughput on long-seq (4k) workloads, p99 latency within +3%, token cost down ~6% on our 8xA100 perf rig. added unit test for prefetch boundary and ran fuzz on seq distribution. CI: one flaky test runtime_tests::kv_integration timed out, investigating.

oliver: about fallback — does this still route to the old prefetch variant when disabled? I don't see a flag to flip at runtime.

morgan: added a flag in config.serving.prefetch.enabled (default true) so we can turn it off for canary. snippet:```
# config snippet
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  lookahead_ms: 30
  max_tokens: 2048
```

kai: quick code skim looks OK; left a couple inline comments re: concurrency and memory ordering. please add an explicit assert for buffer overflow and a short comment about why lookahead_ms=30 is safe.

sasha: one nit: rename lookahead_ms -> prefetch_window_ms or doc the units in the config schema. also add a CHANGELOG entry explaining behavioral change.

morgan: pushed nits + assert. CI rerun now shows the same kv_integration timeout locally with ~5s hang. @dev-bot any logs?

dev-bot: CI run #4321-build-57: runtime_tests::kv_integration timed out after 300s on runner-14. Retriggering build 58...

oliver: I'll try repro on my laptop, might be test harness timing. if we can't stabilize quickly we should gate the change on the release branch (prefetch.enabled=false) and merge the non-blocking parts.

kai: LGTM once the small comment is addressed. @sasha @oliver we need two approvals to merge.

sasha: approving now :+1:

oliver: approved. one follow-up: add a perf-suite regression test so we detect future regressions for long-context workloads.

morgan: thanks all. will add perf-suite ticket and merge after final CI green. release note draft: "improved prefetch and batching reduce token cost and increase throughput for long-context models"

morgan: merge finished, CI build 59 succeeded, merging at head and tagging release branch with prefetch toggle off for canary.
